svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "Noto Sans", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Hermetic git environment across osf
svg.desc: The test harness exports a sentinel GIT_DIR into a nested cargo test; every git-spawning helper in the osf crate scrubs the locating variables before running git or moon, so the sentinel is never written.

g.text: TEST HARNESS · CARGO TEST, NESTED SUITES
OSF CRATE · GIT WRAPPER, MOON, ASSETS
